name: PolyTranslate AI for Polylang
author: almhdy

sections.description:
Save Thousands on Translation Costs! PolyTranslate AI for Polylang is the most cost-effective way to create multilingual WordPress websites.

This powerful plugin transforms your WordPress site into a multilingual powerhouse using cutting-edge AI translation technology. Connect with OpenAI (ChatGPT), DeepL Pro, Google Translate, and OpenRouter using your own API keys for maximum cost control and privacy.

Why Choose PolyTranslate AI?

✅ Massive Cost Savings – Use your own API keys, pay wholesale AI rates
✅ Complete Translation Solution – Posts, pages, products, custom fields, SEO metadata
✅ Advanced Custom Fields Support – Full ACF, Meta Box, and custom fields translation
✅ Professional Quality – AI-powered translations that sound natural
✅ Time-Efficient – Translate entire sites in minutes, not weeks
✅ Privacy-First – Your content never touches our servers
✅ WooCommerce Ready – Perfect for multilingual e-commerce stores

Perfect for:
– E-commerce stores expanding globally
– Blogs and news sites going multilingual
– Corporate websites needing multiple languages
– Agencies managing client multilingual sites
– Anyone tired of expensive translation services

This plugin is not affiliated with the developers of Polylang.

Requirements: This plugin works with Polylang. Make sure you have Polylang installed.

🆓 Free Features

Core Translation Features:
– Translate WordPress posts and pages instantly
– Translate WooCommerce Products (title, description, short description)
– Translate custom post types (any CPT registered in WordPress)
– Multiple AI Engines – Choose between OpenAI, DeepL, Google Translate, OpenRouter
– Language Auto-Detection – Smart source language detection
– One-Click Translation – Translate directly from edit screens

Cost Control:
– Use your own API keys – no markup, no hidden fees
– Transparent pricing – see exactly what each translation costs
– Pay-as-you-use – no monthly subscriptions or minimum commitments

🔥 Premium Features

Advanced Content Translation:
– Advanced Custom Fields (ACF) – Text, textarea, wysiwyg, and more field types
– Meta Box Fields – Complete Meta Box plugin support
– Custom Fields & Meta – Any custom field or post meta
– Taxonomies – Categories, tags, and custom taxonomies
– Elementor Pages – Full Elementor widget and content translation
– Bulk Translation – Translate hundreds of posts with one click

SEO & Marketing:
– Complete SEO Meta Translation for:
– Yoast SEO (meta titles, descriptions, focus keywords)
– Rank Math (titles, descriptions, schemas)
– SEOPress (meta data and social previews)
– All in One SEO Pack (titles, descriptions, keywords)
– Social Media Meta – Open Graph and Twitter Card translations
– Schema Markup – Translate structured data for better SEO

WooCommerce Advanced:
– Product Variations – Translate variable product options
– Product Categories – Complete taxonomy translation
– Product Attributes – Custom attributes and values
– WooCommerce SEO – Product meta for better search rankings

External Services

PolyTranslate AI connects to third-party translation APIs when you trigger translations. You control your data and costs by providing your own API keys:

  1. OpenAI (ChatGPT/GPT-4)

    • Purpose: Premium AI translations with context understanding
    • Data Sent: Content to translate, language codes, your API key
    • Privacy: Direct connection – we never see your content
    • Links: Terms | Privacy

  2. DeepL Pro

    • Purpose: Industry-leading neural machine translation
    • Data Sent: Text content, language pairs, your API key
    • Privacy: Secure API connection, no data retention
    • Links: Terms | Privacy

  3. Google Translate API

    • Purpose: Fast, reliable translations via Google Cloud
    • Data Sent: Content, language codes, your API credentials
    • Privacy: Enterprise-grade security and privacy
    • Links: Terms | Privacy

  4. OpenRouter.ai

    • Purpose: Access to multiple AI models through one API
    • Data Sent: Translation requests, language pairs, your API key
    • Privacy: No data storage, secure transmission
    • Links: Terms | Privacy

Security Promise: Your API keys are encrypted and stored locally in your WordPress database. Plugin updates never transmit your keys or content to our servers.
sections.installation:
Quick Start (2 minutes):

  1. Install Plugin

    • Search “PolyTranslate AI” in WordPress admin → Plugins → Add New
    • Or upload manually to /wp-content/plugins/polytranslate-ai/
    • Activate the plugin

  2. Configure API Keys

    • Go to PolyTranslate AI → Settings
    • Add your API key for OpenAI, DeepL, Google, or OpenRouter

  3. Start Translating

    • Edit any post/page/product
    • Click the Translate button
    • Select target languages
    • Watch the magic happen!
sections.faq:
How much money can I actually save?

Typical savings range from 95-99% compared to professional translation services. A medium-sized business website (20,000 words) would cost $2,000-6,000 with traditional services, but only ~$0.01–$0.02 with PolyTranslate AI using your own API keys.

Is this plugin completely free?

The core plugin is free with powerful translation features. Premium features (ACF fields, bulk translation, advanced SEO support) require a license, but you’ll still save thousands compared to traditional translation methods.

Do I need technical skills to set this up?

No! The setup takes 2 minutes. Just get an API key from OpenAI or DeepL, paste it in the settings, and start translating.

Can I translate Advanced Custom Fields?

Yes! The premium version fully supports ACF fields including text, textarea, WYSIWYG, repeater fields, and more. Also supports Meta Box and other custom field plugins.

Which translation service gives the best results?

For Quality: DeepL Pro > Google Translate
For Cost: Google Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite (~$0.0003/word) > Google Translate (~$0.0005/word) > GPT-3.5 Turbo (~$0.002/word) > DeepL Pro (~$0.005/word)
Best Value: Google Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite offers excellent quality at very competitive costs. You can switch between services anytime to find your perfect balance.

Is my content secure?

Absolutely. Your content goes directly from your site to your chosen AI service using your API keys. We never see, store, or have access to your content or API keys.

Can I translate WooCommerce stores?

Yes! Both free and premium versions support WooCommerce. Premium adds product variations, categories, attributes, and advanced WooCommerce SEO meta translation.

Does it work with page builders?

Premium version supports Elementor fully. Gutenberg works out of the box. Other page builders work for basic content – contact us for specific compatibility questions.

What if I’m not satisfied?

We offer a 7-day money-back guarantee on premium licenses. Plus, you can try all free features without any commitment.

Is this affiliated with Polylang?

No, this is an independent plugin that extends Polylang’s functionality. Polylang handles language management, we handle the AI translation part.
